user_story: As a user, I want to register with the maximum allowed name length so that long names are handled correctly.

positive.title: Register with a valid maximum length name
steps: Enter a name with the maximum allowed length in the name field
Fill in other required fields with valid data
positive.expected_result: User is successfully registered with a maximum length name

negative.title: Attempt to register with a name exceeding maximum length
steps: Enter a name exceeding the maximum allowed length in the name field
Fill in other required fields with valid data
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the name exceeds the maximum allowed length

edge.title: Register with a name that is exactly at the maximum length boundary
steps: Enter a name that is exactly the maximum allowed length in the name field
Fill in other required fields with valid data
edge.expected_result: User is successfully registered with a name at the maximum length boundary
